input.quote: d. Use of Credit Data during the term of this Agreement. Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 8(d) gives TrueLink a worldwide licence to distribute, license, resell and exploit Credit Data (our borrowers' data) - independent exploitation of Client data well beyond processing to deliver the services, which is walk-away territory under this rule and is not cured by the confidentiality provisions in Section 10. Separately, the Agreement gives Client no ownership of, or licence to, the results of the Support Services it pays for (Section 10 only makes them confidential), so the fallback deliverables licence is absent. TrueLink's retained ownership of the Interface (Section 2(d)) already satisfies the vendor tools/know-how element and is left untouched. We therefore target the fallback: narrow the Credit Data grant to processing solely to provide the Hosting and Support Services, and add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the results of the Support Services.

proposal.summary: Narrow TrueLink's Credit Data licence to processing to provide the services, and add a perpetual licence to Support Services results.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we keep our data and receive a lasting licence to what we pay for, so we have narrowed TrueLink's Credit Data rights to processing solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services and added a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to the results of the Support Services. TrueLink's ownership of the Interface is unaffected.
